# Datadog — Datadog for Startups

Up to $100k in credits covering up to a year of free Datadog Pro across the full platform, for Series A or earlier companies referred by an official Datadog partner.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open, but needs an accelerator, VC or partner code |

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $100,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Acceptance expires if credits are not activated within 30 days; terms define the Program End Date as the earliest of credit exhaustion, "the 12-month anniversary of Activation", or removal from the program. Accounts inactive for three months receive a warning and 30 days to begin using products. |
| **When it ends** | Program terms state: "Commencing with the Program End Date, unless the Parties have agreed otherwise in a written Order, Fees will be billed to Customer under the MSA and Customer's self-serve subscription and billing settings at Datadog's then-current rates." |


### Not covered

- current or prior Datadog customers
- companies that have previously received Datadog for Startups credits
- Series B and later startups

> **Stacking:** Terms state Startup Credits "have no cash value, are non-refundable, non-transferable, and may not be applied to taxes or amounts owed for technical, premier support, or professional services."

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

Three stated requirements: "Series A or earlier"; "Must apply through one of our official referral partners"; and "The company must be new to Datadog" — "you cannot be a current or prior Datadog customer, nor can you have previously received DDFS credits." The partner gate is hard: direct applications are not accepted, and the page directs applicants without a partner to their investor, accelerator or startup community contact. The legal terms at https://www.datadoghq.com/legal/datadog-for-startups/ do not restate the funding-stage or partner requirements and state only that "To be eligible for acceptance in the Program, Customer must have a valid Datadog account"; the more restrictive marketing-page criteria are recorded here. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
